configurePresets.name: windows-x86_64
configurePresets.description: Phase 2 contract preset (plans/WINDOWS_IMPL.md sections 3.2 and 5.6). Run on a pinned windows-2022 runner with the MinGW-w64 UCRT64 toolchain and Ninja on PATH, plus the pinned SDL3 source release (-DSDL3_ROOT) and the pinned ANGLE distribution (ROMM_ANGLE_EGL_LIBRARY / ROMM_ANGLE_GLESV2_LIBRARY / ROMM_ANGLE_INCLUDE_DIR, all required at configure time). All Win32 platform sources have landed, so platform source selection is complete: configure proceeds to the SDL3/ANGLE dependency checks above (the remaining external player dependencies) and never falls back to POSIX sources. ROMM_WIN32_SOFTWARE_ONLY stays OFF here: the ANGLE hardware context remains required.

configurePresets.name: windows-x86_64-software-only
configurePresets.description: Temporary pre-ANGLE boundary preset: ROMM_WIN32_SOFTWARE_ONLY=ON excludes the GLES3/ANGLE hardware-context source, import libraries, and include directory, compiles the no-op SdlHardwareContext instead (no unresolved GL API can exist), and makes the player fail closed with launch_failed for every known-hardware-rendering core and every Libretro SET_HW_RENDER / GET_HW_RENDER_INTERFACE request — never silently downgrading. SDL3 remains required (video/audio/input); software cores such as test_core keep full functionality. Intended for Windows CI E2E before the pinned ANGLE distribution lands.
